cinematic_style: An unstyled live-action photograph of a real person, carrying no rendering signature a viewer could name. Fully realistic human proportions with ordinary asymmetry left intact. Skin holds its true texture — visible pores, fine vellus hair, uneven tone — neither smoothed nor sharpened. Surfaces show only the sheen that real skin and real cloth have. Detail is moderate and even across the whole frame, resolved everywhere and emphasised nowhere. No line work, no medium texture, no stylisation of form.

outline.logline: Warehouse manager Jenna begins falling for hardworking rookie Noah, unaware that he is actually the company owner's son working under a hidden identity, until his father unexpectedly reveals the truth in front of her.
outline.main_story:
【The Rookie】
Jenna meets inexperienced warehouse rookie Noah and tells him to follow her onto the floor.

【No Special Treatment】
A medical shipment is stranded, and Noah quietly uses a connection to help find a truck.

【The Man She Respects】
Noah stays late to help Jenna repair a report, changing her opinion of him.

【Rain Between Them】
A radio report about Richard Sterling's son makes Noah test Jenna's feelings without revealing his identity.

【The Truth Almost Told】
Caleb discovers Noah's secret and urges him to confess before the board introduces him.

【His Real Name】
Richard casually identifies Noah as his son, leaving Jenna to question whether their relationship was part of the job.
outline.pace: Warm and steadily building through the workplace beats, then tightening fast once Caleb raises the deadline, snapping shut hard on the reveal.
outline.emotional_tone: Emotionally grounded, concise, and progressively romantic.

beat_plan.title: His Real Name
beat_plan.synopsis: Richard casually identifies Noah as his son, leaving Jenna to question whether their relationship was part of the job.
beat_plan.function: Deliver the serial cliffhanger where the secret is exposed by someone else, at the worst possible moment.
beat_plan.change: The relationship shifts from private trust to public betrayal in a single moment.

assets.space: A high-ceilinged industrial warehouse entrance featuring polished grey concrete flooring and exposed matte steel support beams. A massive corrugated steel roll-up loading door stands open to the exterior loading ramp, framed by painted yellow safety bollards and hazard striping. Along the adjacent perimeter wall, metal fire doors, an industrial wall-mounted clipboard station, and hanging fire extinguishers are affixed to unfinished concrete cinder blocks.

env.light: Bright, low-angled morning sunlight cuts sharply through the open steel roll-up door, casting long diagonal beams and hard geometric shadows across the polished grey concrete floor, balanced by diffuse cool neutral daylight filling the open threshold and the ambient glow from high-bay fluorescent tubes mounted far overhead.

assets.space: An exterior elevated concrete loading dock with heavy black rubber bumper pads along the dock edge, opening outward into a wide asphalt freight bay. Yellow safety-painted edges line the dock rim, and sturdy steel rollup dock doors recede into corrugated metal exterior walls. Stacks of white plastic-wrapped shipping pallets and medical cargo crates rest against the weather-beaten concrete partition wall beside a heavy steel personnel door.

env.light: Soft, overcast morning daylight spreads evenly across the open concrete dock platform and asphalt bay, producing muted, diffused shadows under the roof overhang and highlighting the flat white textures of the plastic-wrapped shipping crates.

assets.space: An elevated supervisor office enclosed by framed interior glass panel walls overlooking the main warehouse floor, with a set of exterior casement windows along the rear wall looking out toward the facility yard. Inside, a scratched laminate double-pedestal desk is flanked by rolling office chairs, grey metal filing cabinets, and corkboards pinned with shift schedules and logistics manifests. The floor is lined with worn commercial vinyl composite tile.

env.light: Fading deep twilight fills the rear exterior windows with cool blue-grey ambient tones, while a single warm tungsten adjustable desk lamp provides a pool of concentrated golden light across the desktop surface and paperwork, leaving the perimeter of the glass-walled office in soft, moody shadow.

assets.space: An exterior industrial staging area beneath a wide, dark corrugated steel overhang extending out from the warehouse's metal-clad exterior wall. The ground consists of weathered concrete and asphalt pavement marked by painted drainage grates and yellow hazard markers. Steel drainage gutters run along the eave edge, framing a view into the open perimeter yard bounded by a chain-link fence.

env.light: Dark night conditions with the distant glow of sodium-vapor amber security lamps casting a warm, diffuse backlighting across the glistening wet asphalt and concrete, creating rim-lit reflections on the water streaming from the metal eaves while the space immediately beneath the overhang remains in deep, soft shadow.

assets.space: A narrow, towering warehouse corridor defined by multi-tier orange and blue steel pallet racking systems loaded high with standardized brown cardboard cartons and shrink-wrapped inventory. The floor is seamless sealed grey concrete marked by faded yellow center guide lines. There are no exterior openings, windows, or skylights along the corridor, which stretches between solid interior concrete walls.

env.light: Even, utilitarian illumination provided by continuous linear fluorescent ceiling strips suspended along the length of the aisle, casting cool neutral white light downward between the tall metal racks with crisp, consistent shadows along the shelving beams and concrete floor.

assets.space: A vast four-way junction at the heart of the main warehouse, where broad transit avenues converge on polished sealed grey concrete marked with crosshatched pedestrian walkways and heavy forklift lanes. Enormous steel support columns rise to a network of open ceiling trusses. Tall clerestory ribbon windows line the distant upper roof monitors along the perimeter walls, while industrial pallet racks and staging zones recede into the distance along all four paths.

env.light: Cool morning daylight filters down through the high clerestory ribbon windows, mixing with broad, steady pools of cool neutral overhead industrial high-bay fluorescent fixtures to evenly illuminate the expansive intersection and reflect off the polished sealed concrete floor.

beats.title: The Rookie
beats.visual_description: Jenna Morales, a seventy-five-year-old woman with a grey chin-length bob and structured jawline, stands beside the open roll-up door holding a dark clipboard. Opposite her stands thirty-year-old Noah Sterling with short sandy blonde hair in his navy polo shirt, bright morning sunlight cutting across the concrete floor between them.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots
beats.seam: Jenna steps forward into the central aisle while Noah matches her stride two paces behind.
beats.preview_narration: Elderly warehouse manager Jenna ran her floor with steady hands, never expecting a newcomer with clean boots and gentle eyes to step into her row.

cuts.script: Jenna holds a clipboard near the metal entrance rolling gate as Noah stands upright in front of her.

dialogue.spoken_text: Clean boots, pressed shirt. You ever actually worked a floor, Noah?

cuts.script: Noah drops his shoulders slightly, keeping his gaze level with Jenna.

dialogue.spoken_text: I learn fast, ma'am. Put me on whatever you need moved.

cuts.script: Jenna taps her pen against the metal clipboard, turning toward the industrial aisles.

dialogue.spoken_text: Call me Jenna. Follow my line, and don't trip over the pallets.

cuts.script: Noah falls in half a step behind Jenna as they head into the main aisle together.

beats.title: No Special Treatment
beats.visual_description: At the elevated concrete loading dock, Jenna Morales with her sharp dark eyes and grey bob faces Noah Sterling beside stacked medical shipping crates under overcast morning light. Behind them, Caleb, with short curly dark hair and light stubble, checks inventory while a refrigerated truck idles in the bay.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots ｜ Caleb: faded denim work shirt over a black t-shirt, dark utility trousers
beats.seam: Noah lifts one corner of the insulated crate as Jenna watches him from the dock edge.
beats.preview_narration: When an urgent shipment nearly spoiled on the dock, Noah solved the crisis with one quiet call, leaving Jenna to wonder who this humble worker really was.

cuts.script: Jenna stares at the empty docking bay while Caleb checks a manifest beside a row of marked insulated crates.

dialogue.spoken_text: Dispatch canceled our refrigerated rig. Those medical crates will spoil by noon.

cuts.script: Noah steps up to the edge of the dock, lowering his handheld radio to his belt.

dialogue.spoken_text: A cold-chain hauler just pulled into bay four. I had them rerouted here.

cuts.script: Jenna turns around quickly, looking from the arriving truck directly at Noah.

dialogue.spoken_text: Dispatch doesn't reroute rigs for rookies. Who did you call?

cuts.script: Noah bends down and takes the front handle of the nearest heavy crate.

dialogue.spoken_text: Just an old friend in logistics. Let's get these loaded first.

beats.title: The Man She Respects
beats.visual_description: Inside the supervisor office at twilight, Jenna Morales and sandy-haired Noah Sterling sit side-by-side at a laminate desk illuminated by a warm tungsten lamp. Jenna rests her weathered hands across a printout while Noah holds a pen poised above an open ledger sheet.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots
beats.seam: Noah checks off an entry on the ledger sheet as Jenna watches him across the lamplit desk.
beats.preview_narration: Working late into the quiet evening, the distance between them softened as Noah stood by her side through every single ledger page.

cuts.script: Jenna sits at a worn wooden desk rubbing her forehead over a stack of mismatched inventory printouts.

dialogue.spoken_text: The quarter counts don't balance. I'll be here until midnight fixing this.

cuts.script: Noah places a paper cup of water on the corner of the desk and pulls up a metal folding chair.

dialogue.spoken_text: Read me the outbound serials. I'll cross-check the depot ledger.

cuts.script: Jenna pauses, her fingers resting flat on the spreadsheet before passing him half the papers.

dialogue.spoken_text: Your shift ended two hours ago, Noah. You don't have to stay.

cuts.script: Noah uncaps a pen and sets the ledger flat between them.

dialogue.spoken_text: I know. But I'd rather finish it with you.

beats.title: Rain Between Them
beats.visual_description: Under the dark corrugated overhang in the rain, Jenna Morales and athletic, broad-shouldered Noah Sterling stand side by side watching the downpour. Amber sodium security lights reflect off the wet asphalt yard, rimming Jenna's grey hair and Noah's damp collar.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots
beats.seam: Noah stands facing Jenna in the sheltered overhang as heavy rain sheets down in front of them.
beats.preview_narration: Under the rush of falling rain, Jenna confessed how much she trusted him, unaware that her honest words were tearing at his secret heart.

cuts.script: Rain pours down from the metal roof awning as a transistor radio on a crate crackles with a local broadcast.

dialogue.spoken_text: Listen to that. Richard Sterling is bringing his son in to run the board. Another heir who never earned a dollar.

cuts.script: Noah stands half a step closer under the narrow overhang, looking into the falling rain.

dialogue.spoken_text: What if the son wanted to prove himself on his own first?

cuts.script: Jenna glances over at him, tilting her head slightly as water drips off the metal eaves.

dialogue.spoken_text: Rich kids don't sweat on concrete, Noah. You're real. That's why I trust you.

cuts.script: Noah turns toward her, his hand pausing on his collar as his expression settles into quiet gravity.

dialogue.spoken_text: Jenna... if there was something about me you didn't know—

beats.title: The Truth Almost Told
beats.visual_description: Between towering steel pallet racks loaded with cardboard cartons, Caleb grips Noah Sterling's arm along the narrow concrete aisle. Caleb's curly dark hair and stubbled jaw are illuminated by the cool overhead fluorescent tube as Noah stands rigid against the blue rack frame.
beats.wardrobe: Noah Sterling: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots ｜ Caleb: faded denim work shirt over a black t-shirt, dark utility trousers
beats.seam: Noah steps briskly into the brightly lit central aisle toward Jenna's distant figure.
beats.preview_narration: Caleb warned him that time had run out, sending Noah racing across the aisles to speak the truth before anyone else could.

cuts.script: Caleb pulls Noah by the arm into the shadow of towering pallet racks, looking down the corridor.

dialogue.spoken_text: Noah, your dad's executive town car just pulled up outside. The whole corporate board is walking in.

cuts.script: Noah steps back against the metal shelving, adjusting the radio on his hip.

dialogue.spoken_text: I'm going to tell Jenna right now. Before he gets down here.

cuts.script: Caleb shakes his head once, releasing Noah's arm as footsteps echo off the polished concrete nearby.

dialogue.spoken_text: Then hurry. If she hears your last name from him instead of you, she'll never forgive it.

cuts.script: Noah strides out from behind the pallet rack toward the main corridor where Jenna is walking.

beats.title: His Real Name
beats.visual_description: At the grand concrete intersection, seventy-five-year-old Richard Sterling with neat silver-grey hair stands tall in his tailored charcoal suit flanked by executives. Nearby, Jenna Morales clutches her clipboard to her chest, backing away from thirty-year-old Noah Sterling whose arm reaches out toward her.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots ｜ Richard Sterling: tailored charcoal grey three-piece suit, crisp white shirt, and a dark silk tie
beats.seam: Jenna stands back from Noah with her clipboard clutched to her chest as Richard watches them both.
beats.preview_narration: Before Noah could whisper his confession, his father entered the floor and shattered Jenna's trust with a single greeting.

cuts.script: Noah catches up to Jenna at the wide aisle crossing, stopping directly in front of her path.

dialogue.spoken_text: Jenna, wait. There's something I need to tell you before anyone comes through those doors.

cuts.script: Richard Sterling walks into the central intersection in a charcoal three-piece suit, flanked by two executives.

dialogue.spoken_text: There you are, son. I see your little trial run on the warehouse floor is finished.

cuts.script: Jenna freezes, looking from Richard's tailored suit to Noah's face as the clipboard slips slightly in her grip.

dialogue.spoken_text: Son? You're Richard Sterling's heir?

cuts.script: Noah takes half a step toward Jenna with his hand reaching out, but Jenna steps backward out of reach.

dialogue.spoken_text: Jenna, listen to me. What happened between us was real.

storyboard.visual_tone: Cool neutral warehouse lighting with practical fluorescent ceiling tubes overhead, contrasted by warm tungsten desk lamps in the office and diffuse amber yard lights in night scenes, highlighting weathered concrete surfaces, matte steel beams, and natural workwear fabrics.
storyboard.video_global_setup:
GLOBAL SETUP
  KEY OBJECTS
    CLIPBOARD: brushed aluminum, standard letter size against a hand, heavy metal clip at the top.
    RADIO: black heavy-duty industrial handheld radio, brick-sized, thick short antenna.
  PERFORMANCE KEY
    JENNA: outward control, tension shows in rigid jaw and quickened blinking, never drops eye contact first.
    NOAH: outward sincerity, pressure shows in lowered shoulders and softened voice, never raises his tone.
    CALEB: relaxed observance, tension shows in tightened lips and shifted weight, never loses his grounded stance.
    RICHARD: outward authority, pressure shows in motionless posture and narrowed gaze, never makes sudden movements.
